Wren & Oak Coffee Roasters

Wren & Oak Coffee Roasters roasts small batches of coffee in Portland, Oregon, sourcing green beans directly from farms in Ethiopia, Colombia, and Sumatra. Every batch is roasted in twenty-pound lots and cupped by hand before it ships, a practice we've followed since opening our doors in 2009.

We sell exclusively through our own site rather than wholesale, which lets us roast to order and get beans to your door within a week of roasting. Learn more about our current lineup on the pricing page, or get in touch if you have questions about a specific origin.
